## 🔴 Critical Issues (2)

### C1. Urban3DCanvas constructor crashes on missing canvas element
- **File:** [`app.js`](file:///C:/Users/Kartik%20Bhosle/.gemini/antigravity/brain/6976d1a8-fd03-4453-a790-acd552e1861a/app.js#L362-L364)
- **Symptom:** `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null` — the constructor calls `this.canvas.getContext('2d')` without checking if `getElementById` returned `null`. Unlike `AmbientEcoCanvas` (which has a guard), `Urban3DCanvas` would crash the entire app if `#urban-3d-canvas` were missing.
- **Fix:** Added early `if (!this.canvas) return;` null guard.

### C2. Canvas context scale accumulates exponentially on resize
- **File:** [`app.js`](file:///C:/Users/Kartik%20Bhosle/.gemini/antigravity/brain/6976d1a8-fd03-4453-a790-acd552e1861a/app.js#L394-L397)
- **Symptom:** Every `resize()` call applies `ctx.scale(devicePixelRatio, ...)` on top of the previous transform. After 3 resizes at 2x DPR, the effective scale becomes 8x — canvas content becomes massively enlarged and blurry.
- **Fix:** Replaced `ctx.scale()` with `ctx.setTransform()` to reset the matrix each call.

---

## 🟠 Major Issues (7)

### M1. Dijkstra produces degenerate results for identical origin/destination
